purpose: Training/evaluation examples for deck market claim extraction.

examples.slide_text: The AI diligence market is a $40B opportunity growing 30% YoY. Investors waste 12 hours per deck.
issues: unclear whether AI diligence is defined category
examples.suggested_fix: Define market as investor/advisory diligence workflow spend, cite source/year, separate TAM from beachhead SAM.

examples.slide_text: Competitors: Notion, ChatGPT, consultants. We are faster and cheaper.
issues: Competitor set mixes tools and services
examples.suggested_fix: Create competitor table by workflow: generic AI, deck tools, consultants, internal analysts.

examples.slide_text: By 2030, compliance automation will be worth $75B globally.
issues: global may not match initial ICP
unclear if compliance automation includes product category
examples.suggested_fix: Add source/year and show SAM for target vertical.

examples.slide_text: Our first market is UK seed-stage VC funds reviewing 100+ decks monthly.
issues: Needs count of UK seed funds
examples.suggested_fix: Estimate bottom-up SAM: number of funds x users x monthly price or service fee.

examples.slide_text: No one else is doing this.
issues: High investor risk; likely false; ignores manual process and adjacent tools
examples.suggested_fix: Replace with: Existing alternatives are manual analyst review, generic AI tools, consultants, and deck design products; our wedge is structured diligence + editable deck intelligence.
